title: Imfihlakalo Yetrone Ekude
intro: Ukumkani onamandla, osikelelwe ngolawulo olungaqhelekanga, wajongana nomngeni ongaqhelekanga owawubandakanya ukumkanikazi ovela kwilizwe elikude. Ukumkani wayefuna ukubonisa amandla nobulumko bukaThixo, eqalisa isiganeko esimangalisayo esasichasene nemithetho yexesha nendawo. Ungayifumana na iinkcukacha zesi siganeko simangalisayo?
clues: Umlawuli wanikwa amandla amakhulu, kuquka ukulawula izidalwa ezingabonakaliyo kunye nokukwazi ukulawula imimoya.
Lo mlawuli wafumana iindaba zokumkanikazi osisityebi owayenqula ilanga, waza wagqiba ekubeni ammemele enkundleni.
Ngaphambi kokufika kokumkanikazi, umlawuli wavakalisa umnqweno wokuzisa isihlalo sakhe samandla esimangalisayo kubukumkani bakhe obukude.
Ijini enamandla yazinikela ukuba iyithathe loo nto ngaphambi kokuba umlawuli aphakame kwibhunga lakhe.
Nangona kunjalo, umntu onolwazi olunzulu ngeZibhalo eziNgcwele wanikela ngokufundwa okukhawulezileyo nangakumbi, egqiba umsebenzi ngokuphanyaza kweliso.
Ekufikeni kwayo, umlawuli wayalela ukuba loo nto iguqulwe ukuze kuvavanywe ingqondo yokumkanikazi kunye nokuqonda kwakhe xa ekugqibeleni efika ebhotwe.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
